paper.title_en: A Primer on Spacetime Singularities II: Spatially Homogeneous Cosmologies
paper.abstract_en: This article is the second part of a review devoted to spacetime singularities in classical General Relativity. While Primer I developed the mathematical framework for defining, classifying, and proving the existence of singularities, the present work examines their concrete realization in spatially homogeneous cosmological models. After reviewing the geometrical foundations of homogeneity and the Bianchi classification, we derive the field equations for orthogonal and tilted perfect fluid cosmologies and use the Kasner and Bianchi I solutions as elementary prototypes of anisotropic singular behaviour. Raychaudhuri focusing provides general conditions under which the homogeneous Cauchy development reaches a finite proper time boundary. We then distinguish matter singularities, characterized by divergent density and Ricci curvature, from more subtle non-scalar or whimper singularities associated with Cauchy horizons and extreme fluid tilt. The classical Ellis-King analysis is reconsidered in the light of later developments, including rigorous curvature-blow-up results for Bianchi VIII and IX models, kinematic singularities in geodesically complete tilted spacetimes, and the recent reappearance of whimper behaviour in dipole cosmology. The resulting picture shows that even spatially homogeneous cosmologies exhibit a remarkably rich hierarchy of singular boundaries. The detailed dynamical approach to these boundaries - Hamiltonian cosmology, Kasner transitions, Mixmaster dynamics and the BKL conjecture - is reserved for Primer III.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 这是一篇关于经典广义相对论中时空奇点的综述性文章第二部分，聚焦空间均匀宇宙学模型。文章系统梳理了齐性与Bianchi分类的几何基础，推导正交与倾斜理想流体宇宙学的场方程，并以Kasner与Bianchi I解作为各向异性奇性行为的原型；还讨论Raychaudhuri聚焦条件、物质奇性与whimper奇性、Bianchi VIII/IX模型的曲率发散结果以及偶极宇宙学中whimper行为的再现。选题属于广义相对论基础中的经典核心问题，理论深度较高，叙述脉络清晰，对研究者有明确的参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 时空奇点入门之二：空间均匀宇宙学
decision.abstract_zh: 本文是关于经典广义相对论中时空奇点的综述的第二部分。Primer I 建立了定义、分类并证明奇点存在的数学框架，而本工作则考察它们在空间均匀宇宙学模型中的具体实现。在回顾均匀性的几何基础与 Bianchi 分类之后，我们推导了正交和倾斜理想流体宇宙学的场方程，并以 Kasner 和 Bianchi I 解作为各向异性奇性行为的基本原型。Raychaudhuri 聚焦给出了均匀 Cauchy 发展达到有限固有时边界的普遍条件。随后我们区分了以密度和 Ricci 曲率发散为特征的物质奇性，与同 Cauchy 视界及极端流体倾斜相关的更微妙的非标量奇性或 whimper 奇性。我们结合后来的发展重新审视经典的 Ellis-King 分析，包括 Bianchi VIII 和 IX 模型的严格曲率发散结果、测地完备倾斜时空中的运动学奇性，以及 whimper 行为在偶极宇宙学中的近期再现。由此得到的图景表明，即使是空间均匀宇宙学也展现出异常丰富的奇性边界层级。对这些边界的详细动力学方法——哈密顿宇宙学、Kasner 跃迁、Mixmaster 动力学与 BKL 猜想——将留待 Primer III 讨论。
